text: BM25 is a sparse lexical retrieval method that scores documents using term frequency, inverse document frequency, and document length normalization.
Reciprocal Rank Fusion combines ranked lists without assuming that BM25 scores and dense cosine similarity are calibrated to the same numeric scale.
A cross-encoder reranker can rescore a smaller candidate set after first-stage retrieval. Retrieval quality should be measured on a frozen evaluation set before and after reranking.
Grounded RAG answers should preserve source identifiers and citations. When retrieval is insufficient, the system should abstain instead of inventing unsupported claims.
